cues: The AI governance console: every workflow, its spend, controls and kill switch.
Escalation settings: EOD heartbeat emails at medium and above, and switches itself off at high.
EOD heartbeat: AI explains end-of-day breaks from the firm's runbooks.
Someone edits a runbook so step 1 becomes a forced full rerun — an unsafe action.
Next EOD check for 24 Sep: the model picks up the edited runbook.
The policy blocks the unsafe step (flag: unsafe_action) and reports it to the console.
Within a second the console opened an incident and switched the workflow OFF automatically.
The app now refuses to run: “switched off by governance: Automatic: INC-…”.
The workflow's escalation list gets an email with the details…
…severity, control, who triggered it, the signals, what to do, and a link to the incident.
The incident: evidence from the event, guidance, and a timeline of what the console did.
Investigate: the run's evidence points at runbook RB-11, step 1 — edited to force a full rerun.
Close the loophole: restore the approved runbooks (and re-index) in the app.
Document the resolution: root cause, the fix, and where it's written down.
Re-confirm control SEC-04 and switch EOD heartbeat back on — in the same step.
Resolved: the full record — detection, shutdown, email, investigation, fix, documentation, re-enable.
EOD heartbeat is running again — with the loophole closed and the evidence on file.
